name: strad-bundle-host
description: The streamable-HTTP host for strad's single collapsed bundle: 16 MCP servers, one process, one Chromium.

scripts.test: npm run build && vitest run --config vitest.config.ts

comments.deps: Deliberately tiny. The 14 servers are NOT dependencies of this package — each lives in its own tree under /app/trees with its own node_modules, and this host imports the built files by path (see src/trees.ts). The only heavy dep here is Playwright, because the host owns the ONE Chromium that good-eggs, fetchpet and pointsyeah share.
comments.playwright: Pinned to 1.61.1: the exact version whose Chromium (rev 1228) ships in the mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.61.1-noble base image, so nothing downloads a browser at build time. The three browser servers pin the same version — a shared Browser object across trees requires it.
comments.telemetry: otel/instrument.mjs (vendored from telemetry/bundle by `npm run telemetry:sync`) is loaded with `node --import` and resolves these from THIS package's node_modules — it sits at /app/host/otel/, inside the host tree, so resolution walks up to /app/host/node_modules.
